items.q: What does ‘S01 Projektmanagement’ mean, and what does ‘S01’ stand for?
items.a:
S01 Projektmanagement (pronounced “es null eins”) is a specialised consulting firm focused on energy infrastructure projects.

The name “S01” goes back to a major project we supported: it designates the first switching block with which a substantial part of the facility was successfully commissioned. This section was not only technically decisive but also a central contractual milestone for our client.

Today “S01” stands symbolically for two things: the successful mastering of complex project phases, and the next step in our own development – from a sole proprietorship to a GmbH, with the aim of growing our team and supporting further energy projects at the highest level.

items.q: What does your project management offering include?
items.a:
We provide comprehensive consulting in project controls, scheduling, stakeholder management, risk analysis and documentation management. In addition, we take on operational tasks such as organising and setting up administrative infrastructure – digitally and efficiently.

We also support our clients on site: in coordination with project participants, in monitoring and tracking measures, and in construction site coordination.

items.q: Which industries or projects do you serve?
items.a:
As a project management consultancy we support companies in developing energy infrastructure projects across all project phases: from planning and feasibility study through execution and commissioning to decommissioning.

Our target clients are utilities, transmission system operators, power plant operators and companies in power transmission, distribution and generation.

items.q: What distinguishes you as project managers?
items.a: We work in a structured, methodical and solution-oriented way. Our focus is on clear communication, precise planning and the ability to make well-founded decisions even in complex situations. We combine analytical thinking with practical experience to lead projects to success efficiently and purposefully.

items.q: Are your services also suitable for smaller projects?
items.a:
Yes, we also support smaller projects that require a structured approach based on established project management methods.

Our focus is on projects in the energy and industrial sectors – particularly high-voltage facilities such as substations and power line connections.
Stakeholder management covers the identification, analysis and engagement of all relevant project participants. The aim is to ensure clear communication and to avoid conflicts early.

items.q: How do you help resolve conflicts between stakeholders?
items.a: We develop clear communication plans, lead workshops and support the moderation of meetings so that conflicts can be addressed in a structured, solution-oriented way.

items.q: What is schedule management, and why does it matter?
items.a:
Schedule management is a central part of project management. It covers the creation, maintenance and alignment of project schedules, the tracking of milestones and contractual dates, and coordination with project participants. The goal is to define realistic timeframes, make dependencies transparent and create a reliable basis for steering the project.

As a consulting service we help you implement these processes efficiently – from analysis to operational support.

items.q: Which tools do you use for schedule management?
items.a: We rely on Microsoft Project. With it we create, maintain and monitor project schedules, track milestones and align timelines efficiently with all project participants.
It covers the creation, maintenance and administration of technical documents such as drawings, reports, minutes and manuals. The goal is to ensure compliance with standards and traceability.

items.q: How often should a risk analysis be carried out during a project?
items.a: A risk analysis is ideally performed at the start of the project and updated regularly throughout its duration. Reviews before critical phases or milestones are especially important – in coordination with the project lead and the relevant stakeholders on the client side. This allows new risks to be identified early and suitable measures to be initiated.

items.q: Do you also work on site?
items.a:
Yes, we work both on site and remotely – flexibly and aligned with the requirements of your project. Regular meetings and site visits are part of our scope and can be arranged individually.

Our headquarters in Eschborn near Frankfurt am Main allows us to reach projects throughout Germany quickly and with minimal effort – centrally located with excellent rail, motorway and airport connections. Wherever possible we deliberately leave the car behind and travel by train to use project time more efficiently. This adds value for our clients and reduces our CO₂ footprint.

This approach is complemented by our digital infrastructure, which enables smooth and efficient collaboration.
Depending on the project, billing is either hourly or as a fixed fee. We agree the model individually with you to ensure transparency and planning certainty.

values.title: Our values
values.text:
At S01 Projektmanagement, clarity, reliability and structure take centre stage. Successful energy infrastructure projects require transparent decisions, clearly defined responsibilities and consistent follow-up of topics and measures.

We critically question existing processes and look for pragmatic, efficient solutions for each project’s requirements. We do not get lost in problems; we concentrate on structured, actionable project controls.

method.title: Our way of working
method.text:
Our role goes beyond consulting – we are part of the team. With an overarching view of all interfaces, we make sure that even complex relationships remain manageable.

Digital tools allow us to combine efficiency and transparency with the flexibility that critical projects demand.

quality.title: Quality and methodology
quality.text: S01 Projektmanagement combines hands-on project experience with internationally recognised standards. Our voluntary ISO 9001:2015 certification and PMP® certification stand for structured processes, traceable ways of working and high quality standards in project controls.

items.title: Online application
items.text: Found an opening that fits you perfectly? Send us your complete documents by email to recruiting@s01-pm.de.

items.title: Review and feedback
items.text: We review your application documents and usually get back to you within 1–2 weeks.

items.title: Personal conversation
items.text: If your profile matches S01, we arrange a first conversation to talk about professional experience, qualifications, expectations and motivation. It usually takes place as a video call and lasts 30–60 minutes.

items.title: Decision
items.text: If you have convinced us, our team will contact you to discuss the next steps. If everything fits, you receive a binding offer.

items.q: Which projects does S01 Projektmanagement work on?
items.a: We specialise in project management for energy infrastructure projects – in particular power generation, transmission and distribution.

items.q: Which qualifications are required for an application?
items.a: We are looking for committed profiles in engineering, business administration, law and finance to drive both technical projects and the development and management of specific business areas. Very good German and English skills are required for all positions.

Yes, some roles can be performed remotely.

Other positions – particularly in project management and administration – mostly require on-site presence, not only in the office but also on construction sites, to ensure close coordination with the team and clients. Details are given in each job description.

items.q: How does the application process work?
items.a: Application by email to recruiting@s01-pm.de. Feedback within 1–2 weeks. A first video interview (30–60 minutes), a second interview on site, then decision and offer.

items.q: Which benefits does S01 Projektmanagement offer?
items.a: Flexible working models, short decision paths, modern tools and professional onboarding, and the chance to actively contribute to the growth and expansion of the company and take on new roles.
